payload.title: Submit-a-link form as a standard component
payload.description:
As a publication builder, I want a standard submit-a-link component, so that a static site gets the form without custom code.

Fields: URL, title with a 90-character counter, type, section, evidence links of closed types, "what you checked", disclosure. Works as a client component on a static page; submit goes to the authenticated mutation. Shows signed-in state and handle.

```gherkin
Feature: Submit form component
  Scenario: Signed-out
    Given a guest on the submit page
    Then the form is replaced by a sign-in prompt

  Scenario: Submit from the form
    Given a signed-in reader
    When the reader fills the form and submits
    Then the item appears as pending and the form shows its status
```
